BiblicalUsage: Baqqarah means a looking after, a careful seeking out, and God uses it when He says He will seek out His sheep in the day they are scattered, as a shepherd seeks out his flock.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God looks after His own the way a shepherd looks after scattered sheep, and no distance or darkness hides them from Him.
